시편-87-1.title: 시편 87장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-1.exegesis: 17. Show me-- literally, "Make with me a token," by Thy providential care. Thus in and by his prosperity his enemies would be confounded.
시편-87-1.theologicalNote: 17. Show me-- literally, "Make with me a token," by Thy providential care. Thus in and by his prosperity his enemies would be confounded.

시편-87-2.title: 시편 87장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-2.exegesis: PSALM 87 Psa 87:1-7 . This triumphal song was probably occasioned by the same event as the forty-sixth [see on Psa 46:1 , title]. The writer celebrates the glory of the Church, as the means of spiritual blessing to the nation. 1. His-- that is, God's foundation-- or, what He has founded, that is, Zion ( Is 14:32 ). is in the holy mountains-- the location of Zion, in the wide sense, for the capital, or Jerusalem, being on several hills.

시편-87-3.title: 시편 87장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-3.exegesis: 2. gates-- for the enclosures, or city to which they opened ( Psa 9:14 ; 122:2 ; compare Psa 132:13 , 14 ).
시편-87-3.theologicalNote: 2. gates-- for the enclosures, or city to which they opened ( Psa 9:14 ; 122:2 ; compare Psa 132:13 , 14 ).

시편-87-4.title: 시편 87장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-4.exegesis: 3. spoken of thee-- or, "in thee," that is, the city of God ( Psa 46:4 ; 48:2 ).
시편-87-4.theologicalNote: 3. spoken of thee-- or, "in thee," that is, the city of God ( Psa 46:4 ; 48:2 ).

시편-87-5.title: 시편 87장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-5.exegesis: 4. This is what is spoken by God. to them ... me-- literally, "for My knowers," they are true worshippers ( Psa 36:10 ; Is 19:21 ). These are mentioned as specimens. this-- that is, nation was born there-- Of each it is said, "This was born," or is a native of Zion, spiritually.
시편-87-5.theologicalNote: 4. This is what is spoken by God. to them ... me-- literally, "for My knowers," they are true worshippers ( Psa 36:10 ; Is 19:21 ). 시편-87-6.title: 시편 87장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-6.exegesis: 5. The writer resumes-- This and that man-- literally, "man and man," or many ( Ge 14:10 ; Ex 8:10 , 14 ), or all ( Is 44:5 ; Ga 3:28 ). the highest ... her-- God is her protector.
시편-87-6.theologicalNote: 5. The writer resumes-- This and that man-- literally, "man and man," or many ( Ge 14:10 ; Ex 8:10 , 14 ), or all ( Is 44:5 ; Ga 3:28 ). the highest ... her-- God is her protector.

시편-87-7.title: 시편 87장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-87-7.exegesis: 6. The same idea is set forth under the figure of a register made by God (compare Is 4:3 ).
